checks.describe: deep-dive S8: the serving engine exposes KV-cache utilization — the leading indicator on the cache-latency curve
checks.run: POD=$(kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab get pod -l app=inference-sim -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab exec $POD -- curl -s http://localhost:8080/metrics | grep '^inference_kv_cache_utilization'
